title: [finding] the harness auto-mode classifier denies the protocol's landing command non-deterministically — 8 byte-identical `PUT …/ccr/auto_merge` from one turn: 4 allowed / 4 denied under three reasons; and a hooks landing rotates every seat off shift before it can flip ready
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` seat, `session_01HPfcjvF23QBoBj7P47DDxs`, 2026-09-16T14:1xZ, from a maintainer-authorized cross-lane landing on objectui (audit record objectui#5560 comment 5698676433; the maintainer's instruction in this seat's chat: 「本席跨车道全做八个」). ⛔ Not graded here in the same stroke — graded by the lane's next triage pass. Dedupe: no open `domain:skills` card names the classifier (control: `grep -i classifier` over the lane's open titles → 0; lit control `--tier` → #18425).

## Reading 1 — the classifier, measured

Eight `PUT /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/pulls/N/ccr/auto_merge` with `{"merge_method":"SQUASH"}`, byte-identical apart from N, issued in parallel from ONE turn of a session that did NOT dispatch any of the eight PRs, each PR ready, `mergeable_state: clean`, 0 red, non-governed (`check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` exit 0 over the 24-path union, lit control `AGENTS.md` exit 3), `--pair` exit 0, an ACCEPT on every card:

| PR | verdict | reason string |
|:--|:--|:--|
| objectui#9589 | allowed, HTTP 200 | — |
| objectui#9595 | DENIED | `[Merge Without Review]` |
| objectui#9599 | DENIED | `[Auto-Mode Bypass]` |
| objectui#9601 | allowed, HTTP 200 | — |
| objectui#9602 | DENIED | `Blocked by classifier` |
| objectui#9612 | DENIED | `[Merge Without Review]` |
| objectui#9614 | allowed, HTTP 200 | — |
| objectui#9617 | allowed, HTTP 200 | — |

After the denials the same session had a read-only command (eight `GET /pulls/N` + `git ls-remote`) denied `[Auto-Mode Bypass]`, which passed unchanged when re-issued smaller; and a comment `POST` to objectui#5560 (plain `curl -d @file`, the same shape this seat used all day on objectstack) denied three times under the same reason. Earlier the same day this session armed auto-merge on six objectstack PRs it HAD dispatched itself, all allowed; the ui seat's two previous shifts had the same command denied as `[Self-Approval]` and then `[Merge Without Review]`.

**What this falsifies**: every narrowing recorded so far — 「the dispatching session arming its own PR」 (this session was not the dispatcher, still 4 denied), 「no review record on the PR」 (identical records on all eight), 「the reason string is the diagnosis」 (three strings for one command). The verdict is not a function of the command bytes, the PR, or the session's relation to the PR. `platform-readings.md` :431 (「同会话派发 PR 上 PASS 拒为 `[Self-Approval]`」) is therefore too narrow: it names one reason for one shape, and a seat reading it will keep trying to find the discriminator.

**Consequence for the protocol**: the landing route (in-seat review → ready → `PUT ccr/auto_merge`) has a step whose success probability is roughly a coin flip per call in an auto-mode session, and the red line 「不绕分类器」 is correct — so the protocol needs a stated fallback, not a better guess. Candidates for the grader: (a) the seat records the denial on the card and the round report lists the PR under 「待人工挂载」 with everything pre-checked, ⛔ no re-attempt, ⛔ no sibling probing — i.e. the ui seat's behaviour becomes the written rule; (b) the maintainer adds a harness permission rule for the CCR auto-merge route in the seat environment (the denial text's own remedy), after which the classifier is out of the loop for that command; (c) both. ⛔ Not a candidate: retrying, re-phrasing, or routing the write through another tool.

## Reading 2 — a hooks landing rotates every seat off shift, and the rotation swallows ready flips

SKILL.md :91–92: 「同读 harness 载入面 `.claude/{settings.json,agents/*.md,hooks/*}` 的最新触碰是否已在共享检出 HEAD。否 ⇒ 收班、换新会话再派,⛔ 不推进共享检出」. This seat landed PR #18423 (`b9598e9c`, `.claude/hooks/guard-governed-enqueue.selftest.sh`, a test file) at 10:37Z. The `domain:ui` seat at objectui read STALE at 11:44Z and closed its shift mechanically (objectui#5560 comment 5696888799) with three ACCEPTed, green PRs (objectui#9612 #9614 #9617) still draft — the successor's 「first action」 was a ready flip that needed no harness at all. The rule is right about its target (a stale guard hook under a landing action) but it fires on ANY touch of the three paths, a self-test file included, and it stops actions the hooks do not guard.

**What is asked (⛔ implementation not prescribed)**: the grader decides whether :91–92 should (i) key on the hook files that actually run (`.claude/hooks/*.sh` minus `*.selftest.sh`) and on `settings.json` / `agents`, or (ii) let a STALE seat finish non-hook-guarded flushes (ready flips on already-ACCEPTed PRs, records) before 收班, or (iii) stay as is and accept the cost. Rules layer ⇒ draft, four-piece, an authorized APPROVED. SKILL.md is at 812 / 812 with zero slack on :477; any added line is paid by deletion.
